description: Human-in-the-loop approval gate for generated therapy plans. Actions: 'approve' (locks and delivers plan), 'reject' (discards), 'modify' (requires feedback, re-generates). This action is irreversible — once approved, the plan is sent for delivery. BEFORE CALLING with action='approve': always show the plan content to the user and get explicit confirmation first.

feedback.description: Required when action = 'modify': describe the changes needed

name: vocametrix_approve_therapy_plan
